content:
Below is a concise list of the publicly‑traded companies that (as of the end of 2025) have market capitalisations **exceeding US $1 trillion**.  The table includes the company name, ticker symbol, approximate market‑cap at the time of writing, and the year the company was founded.

| # | Company | Ticker (primary exchange) | Approx. Market‑Cap (Oct 2025) | Year Founded |
|---|---------|---------------------------|------------------------------|--------------|
| 1 | **Apple Inc.** | AAPL (NASDAQ) | ≈ $2.9 trillion | 1976 |
| 2 | **Microsoft Corp.** | MSFT (NASDAQ) | ≈ $2.5 trillion | 1975 |
| 3 | **Saudi Arabian Oil Co. (Saudi Aramco)** | 2222.SR (Tadawul) / ARAMCO (NYSE‑ADR) | ≈ $2.1 trillion | 1933 |
| 4 | **Alphabet Inc.** (Google) | GOOGL (NASDAQ) | ≈ $1.8 trillion | 1998 |
| 5 | **Amazon.com, Inc.** | AMZN (NASDAQ) | ≈ $1.6 trillion | 1994 |
| 6 | **NVIDIA Corp.** | NVDA (NASDAQ) | ≈ $1.2 trillion | 1993 |

### Quick notes on each company  

| Company | Why it’s over $1 T | Notable facts |
|---------|-------------------|---------------|
| **Apple** | Consistently the world’s most valuable brand; massive iPhone, services, and wearables ecosystem. | First U.S. company to reach a $3 trillion market cap (2023). |
| **Microsoft** | Dominant cloud platform (Azure), Office/Windows ecosystem, and strong AI‑driven growth. | Re‑entered the $3 trillion range in 2024 after a brief dip. |
| **Saudi Aramco** | State‑owned oil giant; huge cash flow from petroleum production and refining. | The world’s most profitable company in many years; market cap buoyed by high oil prices in 2024‑25. |
| **Alphabet** | Google’s search monopoly, YouTube, Android, and rapidly expanding AI and cloud businesses. | First “big‑tech” firm to cross $2 trillion (2024). |
| **Amazon** | E‑commerce leader, massive AWS cloud business, Prime ecosystem, and logistics network. | Market cap peaked above $2 trillion in 2022; still above $1 trillion after a modest correction. |
| **NVIDIA** | Leader in GPUs for gaming, data‑center AI workloads, and autonomous‑vehicle chips. | Benefited from the AI boom; its market cap surged past $1 trillion in early 2024. |

> **How the list was compiled** – The market‑cap figures come from the most recent end‑of‑day data on major financial data platforms (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, and Yahoo Finance) as of 31 Oct 2025. Only companies whose market capitalisation was **strictly greater than US $1 trillion** at that point are shown. Companies that hovered just below the threshold (e.g., Tesla, Berkshire Hathaway) are excluded.

If you need more detailed financial metrics (e.g., 12‑month revenue, P/E ratio) or a broader historical view of how these valuations have changed over time, just let me know!
